data.cultural_impact: The name Atkinson has been locally popular in English speaking regions, particularly in the United States and England, since the Middle Ages. Historically, it was a common surname among farmers and artisans. The surname became more widespread due to the influx of English settlers to the American colonies. Today, Atkinson is still a common name and is often associated with strength, resilience, and determination.
